activity.notes: On 10 December 1991 the Kazakh SSR was renamed the Republic of Kazakhstan and Nazarbayev was inaugurated as its president; independence followed on 16 December. His resignation announced on 19 March 2019 took effect with the presidential succession on 20 March 2019.

sources.title: First President of the Republic of Kazakhstan — official biography
sources.citation_text: The official First President site records Nazarbayev's nationwide election on 1 December 1991 and his role as the first President of Kazakhstan.

sources.title: Political activity — Library of the First President of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.citation_text: The official political chronology states that Nazarbayev became President of the Republic of Kazakhstan in December 1991 and resigned on 19 March 2019, with First President status from 20 March.
